description: Apollo — Colore: Sunshine & silvery gold Collezione: Teatro Codice: 5030 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Small Altezza: 139.5 cm Rapporto: 133.5 cm × 42 cm Toni: Yellow APOLLO is named for the god of light, music, and beauty — one of the few major deities whose name the Romans kept unchanged from the Greek tradition. Its pattern is an interpretation of light and sound waves: large, symmetrical forms that radiate across the surface in a composition that is both architectural and kinetic. The small repeat makes APOLLO ideally suited for statement walls, generous drapery, and expansive upholstery applications . Its classical proportions carry a quiet theatricality — measured, deliberate, and commanding without ornament. Part of the TEATRO collection , APOLLO is printed on cotton with Fortuny's proprietary technique.
